Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
Distinguished Muhammad and his family with honor
And distinguished them with the means (to approach You)
And made them the inheritors of the Prophets

Arabic text: وَ خَتَمَ بِهِمُ الْاَوْصِيَاءَ وَ الْاَئِمَّةَ
Translation: And sealed with them the successors and the Imams

Arabic text: وَ عَلَّمَهُمْ عِلْمَ مَا كَانَ وَ عِلْمَ مَا بَقِيَ
Translation: And taught them the knowledge of what has passed and what remains

Arabic text: وَ جَعَلَ أَفْئِدَةً مِنَ النَّاسِ تَهْوِيْ اِلَيْهِمْ
Translation: And made the hearts of people incline towards them

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his pure family

Arabic text: وَ افْعَلْ بِنَا مَا اَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ فِيْ الدِّيْنِ وَ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ
Translation: And treat us as You are worthy of treating us in religion, in this world, and in the Hereafter
Indeed, You have power over all things
